main.description: The lender's side of a loan, from their answer to a request through to its return. Written to the lender's repo, so it's public: anyone can see who borrowed what.

item.description: AT-URI of the garden.myles.lending.item being lent. Must be in the same repo as this loan.

borrower.description: DID of the person borrowing the item. When request is set, must match the request's author.

request.description: The garden.myles.lending.request this loan answers, if any. Set it when status is declined.

status.description: Where the loan is now. If it disagrees with the timestamps, status wins.

lentAt.description: When the item was handed over.

lentCondition.description: The item's condition when it was handed over. Copied from the item so later edits to it don't change the record.

dueAt.description: When the item should come back.

returnedCondition.description: The item's condition when it came back. Compare with lentCondition to spot wear from the loan.

updatedAt.description: When the loan last changed, e.g. its status.
